basic_details.job_title: UUHF Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Senior Scientist cum Head, Subject Matter Specialist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: VCSG Uttarakhand University of Horticulture & Forestry, Bharsar (UUHF) is filling five posts in two ICAR-funded Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), Bharsar and Ranichauri: one Senior Scientist cum Head (Level 13A) and four Subject Matter Specialists (SMS/T-6, Level 10). Applications go offline by speed or registered post to the Chief Personnel Officer in Dehradun and must reach by 17 December 2026. The posts are co-terminus with the KVK project, and the fee is Rs. 1200/- (Rs. 600/- for SC/ST candidates).

application_fee.details: The fee is paid by Demand Draft enclosed with the application. Application forms received without the prescribed fee will not be entertained, and fee once paid will not be refunded in any case.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format, along with the Score Card, from the University website www.uuhf.ac.in.
Fill in the application form. It asks for personal details, fee payment details, education, professional experience, publications, patents, awards, memberships, two referees and a declaration.
Attach Annexure-I (Score Card, only for Senior Scientist cum Head) or Annexure-II (Score Card, only for Subject Matter Specialist or Equivalent).
Paste a recent passport size self-attested photograph and enclose self-attested copies of supporting documents.

Enclose the Demand Draft for Rs. 1200/- (Rs. 600/- for SC/ST candidates), drawn in favour of Comptroller, Uttarakhand University of Horticulture & Forestry, payable at Punjab National Bank, Branch Pauri.
Write on the envelope: Application for the post of (Name of Post) and (Name of the KVK).

Send it by speed/registered post to: Chief Personnel Officer, Research & Extension Center of VCSG Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry, Nigam Road, Haripur, Selaqui, Dehradun - 248011, Uttarakhand. It must reach latest by 17 December 2026.

Applications submitted by hand or sent by email, fax, courier or any other means will not be accepted. In-service candidates should send the application through proper channel. An advance copy with the application fee should reach the same Dehradun address by the closing date. The form carries an employer endorsement for in-service candidates.
important_instructions: Applications not on the prescribed format, incomplete, or received after the due date will not be considered. The University is not responsible for postal delay. No T.A./D.A. will be paid to candidates called for interview/written test. Canvassing in any form may lead to cancellation of candidature. If any document or information is found incorrect, or information is concealed or suppressed, action may be taken even after appointment, which may lead to termination of services. The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all posts advertised without giving any reason. Legal disputes fall under the District Court at Pauri and the High Court of Uttarakhand. The notice asks candidates to visit the University website regularly for information related to this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: About UUHF
content_sections.text: VCSG Uttarakhand University of Horticulture & Forestry is a university with its office at Bharsar, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand. The advertised posts are in Krishi Vigyan Kendras, a project fully funded by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR). The University recruits for them by direct recruitment on a prescribed application format.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 5 posts, one vacancy each, with the reserved category printed against the post. Total: 5 posts. SC means Scheduled Caste and UR means Unreserved. Only domiciles of Uttarakhand State are eligible under the SC category. The reservation policy of the Uttarakhand State Government applies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice asks for a Doctoral degree in the relevant subject, including relevant basic sciences, with 8 years' experience in the relevant subject. The experience must be as Scientist/Lecturer/Extension Specialist or in an equivalent position in the pay band-3 of Rs. 15600-39100 with Grade Pay of Rs. 5400/ Rs. 6000/ Rs. 7000/ Rs. 8000. The candidate must have made a contribution to research/teaching/extension education, as evidenced by published work and innovations and impact. The four SMS posts need the Master's degree in the subject shown in the table. The maximum age is 42 years, and relaxation for reserved category candidates is provided as per Uttarakhand Govt. rules. Qualifications and experience are counted as on the closing date for submission of applications. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Doctoral degree in relevant subject including relevant basic sciences, with 8 years' experience (details below)
Master's degree in Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Science or equivalent qualification from a recognised University
Master's degree in Soil Science or equivalent qualification from a recognised University
Master's degree in Agroforestry/Forestry or equivalent qualification from a recognised University
Master's degree in Horticulture or equivalent qualification from a recognised University

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Senior Scientist cum Head post carries Level 13A and the four SMS posts carry Level 10 of the 7th CPC. The notice prints no rupee amounts. The posts are in a KVK project funded by ICAR and are co-terminus with the KVK project. There is no provision for transfer of staff between KVKs.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UUHF Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format, along with the Score Card, from the University website www.uuhf.ac.in . Fill in the application form. It asks for personal details, fee payment details, education, professional experience, publications, patents, awards, memberships, two referees and a declaration. Attach Annexure-I (Score Card, only for Senior Scientist cum Head) or Annexure-II (Score Card, only for Subject Matter Specialist or Equivalent). Paste a recent passport size self-attested photograph and enclose self-attested copies of supporting documents. Enclose the Demand Draft for Rs. 1200/- (Rs. 600/- for SC/ST candidates), drawn in favour of Comptroller, Uttarakhand University of Horticulture & Forestry, payable at Punjab National Bank, Branch Pauri. Write on the envelope: Application for the post of (Name of Post) and (Name of the KVK). Send it by speed/registered post to: Chief Personnel Officer, Research & Extension Center of VCSG Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry, Nigam Road, Haripur, Selaqui, Dehradun - 248011, Uttarakhand. It must reach latest by 17 December 2026. Applications submitted by hand or sent by email, fax, courier or any other means will not be accepted. In-service candidates should send the application through proper channel. An advance copy with the application fee should reach the same Dehradun address by the closing date. The form carries an employer endorsement for in-service candidates.

content_sections.heading: Documents Named in the Notice
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form with Annexure-I or Annexure-II Score Card Recent passport size self-attested photograph Self-attested copies of degree certificates and mark sheets Self-attested experience certificates and reprints of publications Self-attested caste certificate, if applicable Demand Draft for the application fee The form also asks for a list of publications with complete citation. Original certificates must be produced at the time of interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid by Demand Draft enclosed with the application. Application forms received without the prescribed fee will not be entertained, and fee once paid will not be refunded in any case.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says the selection process may include a presentation, written test, interview or a combination of all. The recruitment and appointment follow the Statutes and Service Rules of the University. The prescribed qualifications are only the minimum, and mere possession does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. If many applications are received, the University may, at its discretion, screen and shortlist candidates on qualifications, experience, publications etc. For this it may constitute a screening committee. The notice attaches Score Cards for this purpose: Annexure-I (100 marks) for Senior Scientist cum Head and Annexure-II shortlisting criteria for SMS posts. For the SMS posts, the University may also hold a written test, if required, to shortlist candidates for interview. A written test, if given, includes subject-related questions and is of maximum one hour. It is not given for Senior Scientist cum Head. A presentation of maximum 5 minutes related to the concerned discipline, for farmers/livestock owners, may be required.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications not on the prescribed format, incomplete, or received after the due date will not be considered. The University is not responsible for postal delay. No T.A./D.A. will be paid to candidates called for interview/written test. Canvassing in any form may lead to cancellation of candidature. If any document or information is found incorrect, or information is concealed or suppressed, action may be taken even after appointment, which may lead to termination of services. The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all posts advertised without giving any reason. Legal disputes fall under the District Court at Pauri and the High Court of Uttarakhand. The notice asks candidates to visit the University website regularly for information related to this recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UUHF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts, one each: Senior Scientist cum Head and Subject Matter Specialist in Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Science, Soil Science, Agroforestry and Horticulture.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Chief Personnel Officer, Dehradun latest by 17 December 2026 (Thursday).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Senior Scientist cum Head post?
faq.answer: A Doctoral degree in the relevant subject including relevant basic sciences, with 8 years' experience in the relevant subject as Scientist/Lecturer/Extension Specialist or in an equivalent position, as described above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Subject Matter Specialist posts?
faq.answer: A Master's degree or equivalent qualification from a recognised University in Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Science, Soil Science, Agroforestry/Forestry or Horticulture, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 42 years for the posts other than Senior Scientist cum Head. Relaxation for reserved category candidates is as per Uttarakhand Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1200/-, and Rs. 600/- for SC/ST candidates, paid by Demand Draft. It is not refunded.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for UUHF KVK posts?
faq.answer: Download the format from www.uuhf.ac.in, fill it with the Score Card, documents and Demand Draft, and send it by speed/registered post to the Chief Personnel Officer at Selaqui, Dehradun. Hand delivery, email, fax and courier are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The process may include a presentation, written test, interview or a combination. Applications may be screened on qualifications, experience and publications. A written test, if given, is only for SMS posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: The pay is Level 13A for Senior Scientist cum Head and Level 10 for the SMS posts, as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: The posts are in a KVK project funded by ICAR and are co-terminus with the KVK project. There is no provision for transfer of staff between KVKs.
